setting_0.description: hj_reachability 0.7.0 on a uniform grid over the benchmark domain (2D: 500 nodes per dimension, as in the original runners; an even count keeps the NL_SLC singular origin off the grid). Values are reported every time_step_report; verdicts need a margin of margin_cells grid spacings. NL_SLC: the vector field is set to zero inside a disc of radius 0.5 around the singular origin; simulated trajectories from the initial set stay at |x| >= 1.0. CP_LQR UNSAFE/SAFE: 41 nodes per dimension on the grid domain [-1.5,1.5]^3 x [-3,3] instead of the whole benchmark domain; it contains the target box and the simulated trajectory (x1 in [-0.04, 1.00], x2 in [-1.12, 0.53], x3 in [-0.79, 0.45], x4 in [-1.28, 2.20]) with a margin of at least 0.3, and gives spacings 0.075/0.15 instead of 0.25/0.5 (the 1.7 pole-tip target contained no node of the coarse grid).

CP_LQR_FIN_REA_CONVERGE.reason: the target box has half-width 1e-3, far below the spacing of any feasible 4D grid over the domain (about 0.25 with 41 nodes per dimension)

MAS_CON_FIN_REA_BOX.reason: 16-dimensional state space; grid-based Hamilton-Jacobi reachability is infeasible (curse of dimensionality)
